title: Broadcast
list.description: Overlays for OBS, one broadcast per cast channel. Matches marked as casted on a channel show up on its overlays automatically.
list.noChannels: No cast channels yet. Add one to start a broadcast.
dashboard.holdHint: Keeps Next off air until you Take
dashboard.noScannerHint: No scanner is connected, so Next waits for a Take
dashboard.sides.label: Sides
dashboard.duration.label: On air for
dashboard.duration.countdown: The remaining time is counted down on the scene. With Until Take, no countdown is shown.
dashboard.queue.clipMissing: Not every OBS source has this clip yet. Until they do, the scene shows the OBS footage instead.
dashboard.rehearseHint: Plays the transition on the Next preview, nothing goes on air
dashboard.needsMatch: Needs a match cast on this channel
dashboard.matchScenesOff: Rosters, maps and results need a match cast on this channel.
dashboard.noFeaturedMatch: No match is cast on this channel. Mark one as casted (or lock one for it) from the match page.
dashboard.resultsNotOnAir_one: {{count}} result not on air yet: live shows {{live}}, the set is at {{next}}. The next Take puts it on air.
dashboard.resultsNotOnAir_other: {{count}} results not on air yet: live shows {{live}}, the set is at {{next}}. The next Take puts them on air.
dashboard.bracket.explanation: What the bracket scene shows of a double elimination bracket. Remaining shows only the rounds still being played.
dashboard.bracket.none: There is no started bracket to show.
dashboard.team.label: Team
dashboard.team.explanation: Any team of the tournament. The featured match's teams follow the match being cast, in the colors of their sides.
dashboard.clips.label: Clip
dashboard.clips.explanation: Without a clip, the scene shows the footage OBS has under the overlay.
dashboard.setup.clipsSynced: Every OBS source has every replay clip
dashboard.setup.program: In OBS, create a new scene collection (Scene Collection → New) so your own setup stays untouched. Add your capture card and on top of it a Browser source with the URL below, sized 1920×1080 (also set the canvas size in Settings → Video). It switches scenes by itself when you Take.
dashboard.setup.scanner: Start the scanner from this page's header in the browser that sees the game feed without this overlay (your capture card, or OBS Virtual Camera of a scene with only the capture card). It puts scenes waiting for a game start or end on air, in the teams' ink colors. Games still upload to sendou.ink as usual.
dashboard.setup.scannerLinkedElsewhere: This browser's scanner is linked to another broadcast. Linking it here moves it.
dashboard.ink.clear: Clear, back to the theme's colors
dashboard.theme.designHint: Edit every style of the overlays while previewing them over gameplay in made-up situations.
overlay.standBy: Please stand by, we'll be right back
design.title: Designer
design.headline: Headline
design.stylesheetHint: Colors, type, and at the top the sizes and spots everything follows. Saving keeps only what you changed.
design.layoutHint: How the parts are laid out and animated. Most changes are easier in the sizes and spots at the top of the look stylesheet.
design.customHint: Your own CSS, applied after everything else, e.g. for [data-part="team-name"] across every scene.
design.variablesHint: Put the cursor on a line to get shortcuts to its variables, or ⌘/Ctrl + click one to jump to where it is set.
design.syntaxError: Line {{line}}: {{reason}}. The preview shows your last edit that worked.
design.noChanges: Nothing changed from the default styles
design.tooLong: Too many changes to save, at most {{max}} characters fit.
